'''Geoff Bowman''' (DeckTech handle '''GG BLADE'''; GEMP handle '''redv'''<ref name="redv-signup">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=83968 Beezer Bowl: Gemp Parallel Event (RETRO) 29Dec23], Players Committee forum. His reply as RedV (27 December 2023, 3:10 pm) signs up to play ("In! GEMP and Discord: redv") and is signed Geoff Bowman. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012151747/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t83968.html Internet Archive]</ref>)<ref name="dt-23847">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23847 BHBM - Bastard He Bit Me - Well that’s cuz you won], DeckTech (Geoff "GG BLADE" Bowman, 9 June 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/23847/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/23847/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009111844/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23847/ Wayback Machine].</ref> posted a [[Dark]] [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|Bring Him Before Me]] list on DeckTech and played in 2025 Players Committee constructed events.<ref name="pc-2025">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2025-01-las-vegas-grand-prix-las-vegas-nevada-jan-11-12-2025/ 2025 Las Vegas Grand Prix], starwarsccg.org</ref>
